title: Cart Sheet
description:
This component is initially based on the Shopify standard.

## 🧑‍💼 User Story

**As an online shopper**,  
I want to view and manage my cart in an on-page overlay or side drawer (cart sheet)  
So that I can quickly:

* see which items I've added (including variant, quantity, stock status)
* apply discount codes
* understand potential savings (discount, free-shipping threshold)
* estimate shipping costs or tax
* checkout securely using my preferred payment method  
  without leaving the current page

---

enrichedData.purpose: Enables shoppers to view and manage their cart in a non-disruptive side drawer overlay, allowing them to review items, apply discounts, estimate costs, and proceed to checkout without leaving the current page.
useCases: Display cart items with thumbnail, title, variant details, and pricing
Adjust item quantities with real-time cart updates
Remove items from cart via trash icon or remove link
Apply discount codes and display updated totals
Show free-shipping progress bar with dynamic threshold messaging
Display cost breakdown including subtotal, discounts, shipping, and tax
Support currency localization based on shopper locale
Provide prominent checkout button with accepted payment method logos
Capture custom cart attributes for special instructions
Ensure accessibility with ARIA roles, focus management, and keyboard navigation
